source: GET https://router.huggingface.co/v1/models (public, no key). Prices: USD per 1M tokens, cheapest live provider. Docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index
fields: id = router model id (a suffix such as :cheapest is allowed); slug = output directory name; reasoning_effort = low|medium|high or null (null: parameter not sent); enabled = run by default; prices are only used for the dry-run cost estimate.
